description: Where the Accounts link page returns to the app that opened it with `app=1`: a fixed scheme, never a URL taken from the request (APP_CALLBACK, src/client/link-matrix.page.ts). SuperMessage's web authentication session listens for the scheme and reads the Matrix id the page linked (`linked_mxid`, crates/supermessage-core/src/account_link.rs).

mxid.description: The Matrix user id Accounts linked, `@localpart:server name`.
